frozen_and_not_touched: wp5_common.MASS_GRID and every repair_v1..v6 artifact; the extension uses its own file prefix and its own mass grid, passed through the new inject_curve(mass_grid=...) argument whose default is the frozen grid
seed_recipe: fresh default_rng(SEED) per node, matching the repair_v6 node recipe, so each extension shares its parent node's donor, binary and extinction realization
per_node_turnoff_cap: each node's grid is truncated at the interpolated isochrone turnoff at its truth age (issue #14); above it the PMS/MS locus does not exist and the star is dead by construction
verification_obligations: V3 — no extension mass exceeds its node's turnoff (enforced here)
